principle: An open license makes an asset reusable, not visually valid. Every lead still needs spontaneous naming evidence before activation.

items.preferredForm: small mound or pile of earth/sand, mound visually dominant
items.contextualCue: a shovel may help disambiguate the mound but contributes no sound
items.nextAction: continue open-source search; do not manufacture a validated-looking asset from unrelated parts

items.preferredForm: a note whose staff position unambiguously denotes do in the chosen convention

items.nextAction: define an explicit do-placement stimulus and test whether people answer do rather than note or musique; keep dos separate
